svg.title: Hierarchical sparse indexer
svg.desc: The hierarchical sparse indexer is used only in the decoder. For one query the first Full layer scores every causally visible main-KV position, picks its own top-k, and builds a candidate pool from the blocks with the largest block-max scores. Later Reindex layers score only positions in the pool and pick their own top-k; Reuse layers score nothing and reuse the latest selection. The pool is larger than the final top-k.
svg.text: decoder only · the first Full layer
builds a candidate pool and later
Reindex layers score only inside it

text.tspan: ① First Full layer · scores everything
own top-3 + candidate blocks by block-max
② Reindex layer · scores the pool
own top-3 inside the pool (may differ from ①)
③ Reuse layer · no new scoring
